environment: Pillow/FreeType runtime, 1000 UPM TrueType research fonts
initial_execution_failure: Original harness emitted cubic outlines into TrueType glyf format 0 and FontBuilder rejected O. Harness corrected by converting cubic construction curves through Cu2QuPen before glyf serialization.
qualitative_raster_observations: A is visibly the darkest/most compact control; C is visibly the lightest/most open; B remains intermediate at 14, 17 and 24 px.
The current lowercase n construction has an overly rectangular shoulder and is not coherent enough with round o to treat the family as visually resolved.
At 14 px all three controls remain distinguishable, but the comparison is dominated partly by stem mass as well as spacing; therefore spacing preference cannot be isolated from drawing yet.
B remains a defensible working direction, but not a final selected family: lowercase drawing revision is required before extending to kerning.
evidence_limits: C numeric measurements are reproducible from the corrected harness but this summary intentionally records only representative A/B advances; the raster sheet remains the comparative visual evidence.
